name: smwblocks-special-coin
title: Special Coin
description:
A special kind of coin.

If mario collects 5 of these, he will be turn big if he was small, turn into Fire Mario if he was big, or get a 1-up if he was Fire or Cape Mario.

Powerup changing also plays the sound effect and animation.

The graphics still change into the brick if mario hits a blue POW, you have to change the graphics yourself if you want to fix that.
